name: Data analytics
description: Question -> scoped query -> analyze -> chart -> review. Produces query, results, chart, assumptions, and a reproducible report.

steps.title: Scope query for: {{question}}

steps.title: Run and analyze: {{question}}
steps.acceptance: Results come from an actual execution with row counts.

steps.title: Chart results for: {{question}}

steps.acceptance: Assumptions checked; report reproducible from query + code.
